work.title: About me
work.quote: If you work, it will work.
work.desc: I started my journey in development back in 2021 as a frontend mentor, and today I lead a team as a Team Lead. Along the way I grew from building interfaces to designing architecture and shipping full production platforms. I work across the whole stack: React / Next.js on the frontend and Bun / Hono / Node.js on the backend. I'm a self-taught developer and I keep learning every day.

organizations.desc: I lead the development team: assigning tasks, running code reviews, managing workflows in Linear. I design architecture and build a range of production platforms as a fullstack developer.

Single-handedly built the entire frontend of the Online Education platform (LMS): user dashboards, video lessons, a learning content editor, PDF certificate generation and analytics dashboards (backend in Django).
Taught frontend development to kids and adults: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React. 6-month courses, 2–3 groups daily. Brought students from zero to a junior level.

portfolio.title: Selected projects
portfolio.subtitle: Production products I worked on as a fullstack developer and team lead.

projects.title: MNazorat
projects.description: A platform for monitoring and controlling organizations' business processes, with a mobile app and a face-recognition module.

caseStudy.problem: Organizations had no single system to monitor and control business processes in real time.
caseStudy.role: Backend architecture and system design; integration of the mobile app and face-recognition module.
caseStudy.solution: A monitoring platform built on NestJS + Prisma + PostgreSQL, with Redis for caching/queues and Docker deployment. A mobile app and face-recognition module were added.
caseStudy.lessons: Breaking a complex domain into clear modules with well-defined interfaces between services keeps the system maintainable.

projects.title: M-Smart School
projects.description: A school management platform: students, attendance, payments and reports. Monorepo with shared types.

caseStudy.problem: Schools tracked attendance, payments and reports manually — time was wasted, errors were common, and there was no transparency for parents.
caseStudy.role: Team lead and lead developer: architecture, monorepo, backend and self-hosted infrastructure.
caseStudy.solution: A type-safe API (Bun + Hono), monorepo, JWT authentication and a modular system. Attendance, payments and reports on one platform. Self-hosted infrastructure and integration with GPU services (face recognition).
caseStudy.lessons: I learned that working with real users, managing infrastructure and coordinating a team matters more than the technology itself.

projects.title: M-Smart Kids
projects.description: A system for kindergartens: face recognition (FaceID) for attendance and an online payment module.

projects.title: e-Jarima maydon
projects.description: A parking violation system: license-plate recognition from cameras (RTSP / FFmpeg), thermal receipt printing, Electron desktop app.

caseStudy.problem: Recording parking violations manually was slow and error-prone.
caseStudy.role: Lead developer for the desktop app and camera/printer integration.
caseStudy.solution: License-plate recognition from cameras (ANPR, RTSP/FFmpeg), thermal receipt printing, and an Electron desktop client. The fine-issuing process was automated.
caseStudy.lessons: When working with hardware (cameras, printers), reliability and error handling turned out to be the biggest part of the software.

projects.title: Monro Delivery
projects.description: Cafe digitization: backend, admin panel and a mobile API for customer and courier, with job queues.

caseStudy.problem: The ordering, admin and delivery processes of the "Monro" cafe were not digitized.
caseStudy.role: Fullstack: backend, admin panel and mobile API.
caseStudy.solution: A Bun + Hono + Drizzle ORM backend, a queue system with BullMQ, an admin panel and a mobile API. Managed via Linear.
caseStudy.lessons: Even for a small business, the right queue architecture is essential for reliable operation.
